answer: My answer is quorum grading. Each answer is scored by a random quorum of independent graders and only the median survives, so a single colluding grader cannot push junk through and a coordinated ring must capture a whole quorum. Think of the echo as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the plume of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the saffron it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
